question: Two equal circles of radius 6 cm intersect each other such that each pass through the centre of the other. The length (in cm) of the common chord is:
solution:
Given:

The distance between the center of circles is equal to 6 cm.

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca2cedecd3b684a82b8b5ae47b7850651245b99285f5fb6283d1972f46027ffd.png] 

Let the common chord AB perpendicular bisect the distance between the center XY at O

⇒ XO = XY/2 = 6/2 = 3 cm

⇒ AX = radius = 6 (The circles pass through each other’s center)

Now, in triangle XAO right angled at O

⇒ AX² = AO² + XO²

⇒ 6² = AO² + 3²

⇒ AO² = 36 - 9

⇒ AO = 3√3

⇒ AB = 2 × AO = 6√3 cm

∴ The correct answer is 6√3 cm.
